scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names game,worker --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @fishing/game" "npm run dev --workspace @fishing/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:game && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:game && npm run build:worker:staging
scripts.build:worker:staging: npm run staging:config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --config .wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply fishing-with-friends --local --env development
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply fishing-with-friends --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrations: wrangler d1 migrations list fishing-with-friends --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: npm run staging:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply fishing-with-friends-staging --remote --env staging --config .wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:staging: npm run staging:config && wrangler d1 migrations list fishing-with-friends-staging --remote --env staging --config .wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build:game && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:game && npm run staging:config && wrangler deploy --env staging --config .wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.secret:set:telegram:staging: npm run staging:config && node scripts/set-worker-secret.mjs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN staging STAGING_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN .wrangler.staging.jsonc
